audit.why: Early poke phase is Karma's (Mantra Q range 950), mid evens at E, Viktor owns 6 onward — matches 52.22% WR over 8348 games and the content chart.
Spikes recorded: E at 3 evens waveclear, 6 is Viktor's real ult spike vs Karma's none, first item and late compound. Content spikes[] carries all four.

audit.whatIsWrong: Viktor's E called 'Death Ray' in spikes[0].text and content mid; 20 misgendered fields; breakdown.cooldowns has no digit; Chaos Storm channel vs her CC never stated.
audit.why: Kit: 'fire a Hextech Ray'. Karma is she/her. Her Mantra is 40/38/36/34s reduced by her damaging abilities; Focused Resolve is a flat 12s root and heals on the Mantra version — anti-heal and channel-cancel both apply (missingInteractions).

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers in the cooldown field.

edits.before: Once you have E (Death Ray) you can match her waveclear and stop feeding free RQ (Mantra Inner Flame) poke. Bank Q (Siphon Power) shields against her empowered Q and sweep E through the wave so she can't zone you off CS.

edits.before: By lvl 3 Death Ray evens the lane and lvls 4-5 are a straight skill fight over wave control. Manage your Q shields against her empowered Q, clear with E, and don't overstep into her Mantra windows and the lane stabilizes.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Gravity Field has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve is a flat 12s — the root tether that also cancels your Chaos Storm channel, so only ult once it's spent. - Mantra reads 40s but her passive refunds it fast; never assume it's down twice in a row. - Your W is 17s: one job, the moment it goes wrong.
